text:
alex_sales: Heads-up team — Oxbridge just sent a ~80-question security questionnaire (CAIQ-style) and wants answers before their POC kickoff next Monday. Can we triage? Link: https://drive.google.com/oxbridge/CAIQ (pdf attached)

nisha_security: Thanks Alex. Can you confirm which sections they flagged as blockers? I'll start splitting ownership. @ben_pm FYI.

alex_sales: They specifically called out encryption (BYOK/HSM), data residency, and service isolation. Also Qs about SOC2 scope and annual pentest. I'll upload the PDF to the shared folder in a sec.

security-bot: New intake created: ticket S-4392 · Priority: P2 · Submitted by alex_sales

ben_pm: Timeline? POC kickoff is Monday — do we need answers sooner for legal review?

matt_platform: I can own infra/network answers. Need to know whether their POC will use our hosted API or dedicated capacity. That affects BYOK options.

nisha_security: I'll take access controls, incident response, and SOC2 evidence. ella_support — can you grab SOC2 certs and pentest report (if available) and add to the folder?

alex_sales: Uploaded initial scan + a handful of suggested draft answers here:
```
s3://redwood-sec-intake/oxbridge/CAIQ-answers-draft-v0.xlsx
Owner: alex_sales
Notes: encryption = asks for HSM BYOK; data residency = EU-only; PTA = yes
```

ella_support: Got it — I'll upload SOC2 report and last pentest writeup by Thu EOD. Also will collect screenshots for config items.

nisha_security: Important: BYOK with a hardware HSM is only supported on Redwood Private or Dedicated with customer-managed KMS. That could be a blocker for hosted plan. We should propose mitigation: Dedicated + KMS integration or scoped exception for POC with strict temp keys. :warning:

alex_sales: Confirmed they want HSM BYOK. Can we scope Dedicated for the POC? cc @matt_platform

matt_platform: We can propose Dedicated + KMS integration as an option. Need to verify capacity and region availability for their EU region — I'll ping infra. If not available, propose a limited-scoped POC with strict ephemeral keys and audit logging.

security-bot: Ticket S-4392 updated: state -> awaiting_security_owner_assignment; assignees -> nisha_security, matt_platform, ella_support

ben_pm: I'll update the POC runbook and push a deadline: draft answers by Fri 6pm so legal can review Mon morning.

alex_sales: Thanks — I'll loop Oxbridge and ask if they can stretch to next Mon if we need it, but cornering for Fri now. Will post any responses here.

nisha_security: OK — owners assigned. Please add any client-specific evidence to the folder and ping me if Oxbridge pushes new clarifications. :white_check_mark:
